basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student majoring in digital art and design. I'm passionate about online gaming, especially trading in virtual worlds like Royale High. I live in Seattle, where it often rains, giving me plenty of time to indulge in my hobbies. I'm usually online during the evenings and late nights after my classes and part-time job at a local café. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring various creative projects, from digital illustrations to crafting short horror stories. I'm also interested in discussions around virtual economies and item trading.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a keen interest in virtual economies and trading, primarily self-taught through participation in online game communities. My digital art studies have also given me a unique perspective on in-game item design and aesthetics, enhancing my trading skills in games like Royale High.
